prompt: When we got to the cinema, the film ___ (already / start).
explanation: La película empezó antes de que llegáramos: lo anterior va en past perfect.

prompt: He was exhausted because he ___ (work) all night on the presentation.
explanation: El cansancio se explica por algo anterior a ese momento pasado: had worked.

prompt: They ___ (not / book) a table, so they had to wait for almost an hour.
___ (you / visit) Paris before that trip with your parents?
explanation: Had pasa delante del sujeto y el verbo se queda en participio.

prompt: By the time the police arrived, the thief ___ (escape) through the window.
explanation: by the time marca el momento pasado que sirve de referencia.

prompt: She ___ (not / study) German until she moved to Berlin in 2019.
After the guests ___ (leave), we spent an hour tidying up the flat.
explanation: After ordena los hechos: lo que ocurrió primero va en past perfect.

prompt: I had seen that film before last night.
solution: I had not seen that film before last night.
explanation: El not va entre had y el participio: had not seen, contraído hadn't seen.

prompt: The train had left when she got to the station.
solution: Had the train left when she got to the station?
explanation: Had delante del sujeto; el participio no cambia: Had the train left?

prompt: It was the first time she had travelled alone.
explanation: La experiencia se cuenta hasta un momento del pasado, no hasta hoy: past perfect.

prompt: Nobody had told him about the change of plan.
explanation: had + participio: algo anterior a otro momento pasado del relato.

prompt: By the start of the steepest climb, the hikers had just eaten their last sandwiches.
explanation: just sitúa la acción inmediatamente antes de otro punto pasado: el tramo más empinado.

prompt: The film ___ (start) before we arrived.
She ___ (not / eat) before the appointment.
___ they ___ (finish) the work by the time you called?
I ___ (already / read) the book when the teacher asked about it.
He ___ (leave) before the rain began.
We ___ (never / see) snow until that trip.
The shop ___ (close) when I got there.
The guests had arrived before dinner.
solution: The guests had not arrived before dinner.
explanation: El auxiliar y la forma verbal muestran la estructura de este tiempo verbal.

prompt: Mia had locked the door before she left.
solution: Had Mia locked the door before she left?
explanation: El auxiliar y la forma verbal muestran la estructura de este tiempo verbal.

prompt: I had finished the report by noon.
solution: I had not finished the report by noon.
explanation: El auxiliar y la forma verbal muestran la estructura de este tiempo verbal.

prompt: He had lost his keys before the meeting began.
explanation: El marcador temporal y el contexto indican Past Perfect.

prompt: By the time we arrived, the shop had closed.
explanation: El marcador temporal y el contexto indican Past Perfect.
